If you\'re under 13, your mom, dad or guardian needs to approve before you can create an account. Enter your parent\'s email address and we\'ll send them a code. Get the code from your parent and enter it on the next screen. If you\'re creating the account with your parent\'s email, you can enter the same address.
Your parent will see this in the email:

• Your email address, name and year of birth
• How you heard about us and how well you know the abacus
• Your lesson progress, scores, streak and trophies
• Your name and avatar are visible to other users (profile, rankings, following)
• Messages you write to Sobi, the AI helper: they go to Anthropic for the reply, without your name or email
• If you join a course class, the teacher sees your name and lesson progress
• Device ID and usage statistics for notifications
If your parent doesn\'t approve, the account won\'t be created and your sign-up request will be deleted automatically.
